from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
import pathlib
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import tomllib
import types
from tools.mir_executor.local_hooks import local_config
from tools.mir_executor import policy
"""DispatchBrief contract for execution-lane handoff and durable resume."""



from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator


class DispatchBriefSourceRefs(BaseModel):
    """Source references used to derive a dispatch brief."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)

    task_spec: str = Field(min_length=1)
    plan: str = Field(default="tasks/plan.md")
    phase: str = Field(min_length=1)


class DispatchBrief(BaseModel):
    """Execution-ready handoff artifact for one target agent and one slice."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)

    version: int = Field(default=1)
    task_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
    phase_id: str | None = None
    slice_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
    target_agent: str = Field(min_length=1)
    user_intent: str = Field(min_length=1)
    expanded_goal: str = Field(min_length=1)
    owned_scope: tuple[str, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    out_of_scope: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    verification_commands: tuple[str, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    stop_conditions: tuple[str, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    handoff_refs: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    tdd_change_refs: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    resume_state_ref: str = Field(min_length=1)
    source_refs: DispatchBriefSourceRefs

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _validate_contract(self) -> DispatchBrief:
        if self.version != 1:
            raise ValueError("DispatchBrief.version must be 1")
        expected_resume_ref = f"tasks/dispatch/{self.task_id}/{self.slice_id}.json"
        if self.resume_state_ref != expected_resume_ref:
            raise ValueError(f"DispatchBrief.resume_state_ref must match {expected_resume_ref!r}")
        if self.source_refs.plan != "tasks/plan.md":
            raise ValueError("DispatchBrief.source_refs.plan must be 'tasks/plan.md'")
        return self

DispatchBrief.__module__ = "mir.core.contracts.dispatch_brief"
DispatchBriefSourceRefs.__module__ = "mir.core.contracts.dispatch_brief"

def load_dispatch_brief(path: Path) -> DispatchBrief:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    return DispatchBrief(**payload)
_PACKET = 'mir.development-packet/1'
_PACKET_FIELDS = frozenset({'packet', 'task', 'kind', 'refs', 'verify', 'target_agent'})
_PACKET_KINDS = frozenset({'fix', 'feature', 'refactor', 'test'})
_MAX_TASK_CHARS = 160
_MAX_REFS = 20
_SYMBOL = re.compile('[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(::[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*')
_AGENT = re.compile('[a-z][a-z0-9-]*')

def validate_brief(brief: pathlib.Path | str, repo_root: pathlib.Path):
    if isinstance(brief, pathlib.Path):
        from mir.core.conductor.dispatch_brief import load_dispatch_brief
        loaded = load_dispatch_brief(brief)
        packet = _development_packet(loaded.expanded_goal, repo_root)
        packet.setdefault('target_agent', loaded.target_agent)
        return packet
    return _development_packet(brief, repo_root)

def render_brief(packet: dict, repo_root: pathlib.Path) -> str:
    return json.dumps(packet, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)

def _unique_object(pairs: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> dict:
    keys = [key for key, _value in pairs]
    if len(keys) != len(set(keys)):
        raise ValueError('development packet must not repeat a key')
    return dict(pairs)

def _development_packet(text: object, repo_root: pathlib.Path) -> dict:
    try:
        packet = json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=_unique_object) if isinstance(text, str) else None
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        packet = None
    if not isinstance(packet, dict) or packet.get('packet') != _PACKET:
        raise ValueError(f'development dispatch accepts only a typed packet ({_PACKET})')
    unknown = set(packet) - _PACKET_FIELDS
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f'packet has untyped fields: {sorted(unknown)}')
    task = packet.get('task')
    if not (isinstance(task, str) and task.strip() and (len(task) <= _MAX_TASK_CHARS) and task.isprintable()):
        raise ValueError(f'packet task must be one printable line of <= {_MAX_TASK_CHARS} chars')
    if packet.get('kind') not in _PACKET_KINDS:
        raise ValueError(f'packet kind must be one of {sorted(_PACKET_KINDS)}')
    refs = packet.get('refs')
    if not isinstance(refs, list) or not 1 <= len(refs) <= _MAX_REFS:
        raise ValueError(f'packet refs must list 1-{_MAX_REFS} technical references')
    config = local_config(repo_root)
    prefixes = tuple(config.get('development_packet', {}).get('ref_prefixes', ()))
    for ref in refs:
        _check_ref(ref, prefixes, pathlib.Path(repo_root))
    verify = packet.get('verify', [])
    if not isinstance(verify, list) or any((not isinstance(name, str) or name not in config.get('verifiers', {}) for name in verify)):
        raise ValueError('packet verify must name registered verifier IDs')
    agent = packet.get('target_agent')
    if agent is not None and (not (isinstance(agent, str) and _AGENT.fullmatch(agent))):
        raise ValueError('packet target_agent must be an agent name')
    return packet

def _check_ref(ref: object, prefixes: tuple[str, ...], repo_root: pathlib.Path) -> None:
    if not isinstance(ref, str):
        raise ValueError('packet ref must be a string')
    path, _, symbol = ref.partition('::')
    parts = pathlib.PurePosixPath(path).parts
    if not prefixes or not path.startswith(prefixes) or path.startswith('/') or ('\\' in path) or ('..' in parts) or (symbol and (not _SYMBOL.fullmatch(symbol))):
        raise ValueError(f'packet ref is not an allowlisted technical reference: {ref!r}')
    tracked = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repo_root), 'ls-files', '--error-unmatch', '--', path], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    target = repo_root / path
    if tracked.returncode != 0 or target.is_symlink() or (not target.is_file()):
        raise ValueError(f'packet ref is not a tracked regular file: {ref!r}')

def pre_execute(args: argparse.Namespace, repo_root: pathlib.Path) -> None:
    _refuse_family(args)
    _require_packet_argv(args, repo_root)
    _map_verify_commands(args, repo_root)

def _require_packet_argv(args: argparse.Namespace, repo_root: pathlib.Path) -> None:
    file = getattr(args, 'codex_args_file', None)
    text = getattr(args, 'codex_args', None)
    if file is not None:
        prompt = pathlib.Path(file).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    elif text is not None:
        from tools.mir_executor.cli import _prompt_from_codex_args
        prompt = _prompt_from_codex_args(shlex.split(text))
    else:
        return
    _development_packet(prompt, repo_root)

def _refuse_family(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    if getattr(args, 'family', None) is None:
        return
    print('[mir_executor] --family is unavailable here: this repository has no profile_compiler family registry (fleet-manager repositories only). Pass --repo-root instead.', file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)

def _map_verify_commands(args: argparse.Namespace, repo_root: pathlib.Path) -> None:
    commands = getattr(args, 'verify_cmds', None)
    if not commands:
        return
    verifiers = local_config(repo_root).get('verifiers', {})
    by_argv = {tuple(argv): verifier_id for verifier_id, argv in verifiers.items()}
    mapped = []
    for command in commands:
        if command not in verifiers:
            try:
                command = by_argv.get(tuple(shlex.split(command)), command)
            except ValueError:
                pass
        mapped.append(command)
    args.verify_cmds = mapped
_loader = types.ModuleType("mir.core.conductor.dispatch_brief")
_loader.load_dispatch_brief = load_dispatch_brief
sys.modules[_loader.__name__] = _loader
